description: Register an assisted or self custody account (ADR-003). The client put the DID's genesis operation in PLC: rotation keys [the user's key] (self) or [the user's key, the key from account.reserveCustodyKey] (assisted), signed by the user's key; verificationMethods.atproto from com.atproto.server.reserveSigningKey and openfederation_owner = the user's owner key; this server's endpoint; at://<handle><suffix>. Same rules as account.register (invite, email, password, approval).

main.description: Register an assisted or self custody account whose genesis operation is already in PLC.

handle.description: The label, or the full handle with this server's handle domain; must match the genesis operation's at:// handle. The response gives the full handle.

status.description: 'pending' until an admin approves it, or 'approved' when the server approves new accounts automatically.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: Missing or invalid did, mode, handle, email or password.

errors.name: CustodyModeNotAllowed
errors.description: This server's policy does not allow the mode (IDENTITY_CUSTODY_ALLOWED).

errors.name: InvalidGenesis
errors.description: The DID's PLC history is not exactly a genesis operation that matches the mode, this server, the handle and the keys.

errors.name: SigningKeyNotReserved
errors.description: The atproto key was not reserved here.

errors.name: PdsKeyNotReserved
errors.description: The second rotation key (assisted) was not reserved here, or was already used.

errors.name: AccountExists
errors.description: Handle, email or DID already in use.
